info.name: Job Portal System API
info.description:
Postman collection for all Job Portal System backend services.

## Conventions
- **One top-level folder per microservice** (e.g. `User Service`, `Job Service`, ...), one subfolder per controller.
- **Collection variables** (see `Variables` tab):
  - `baseUrl` — target host, defaults to `http://localhost:5001`
  - `accessToken` / `refreshToken` — auto-saved by the `Login` and `Refresh` test scripts
  - `userId` — the record used by `GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE /api/users/{id}` requests
  - `companyBaseUrl` — company-service host, defaults to `http://localhost:5002`
  - `companyId` / `locationId` — ids used by the Company Service requests
  - `resumeBaseUrl` — resume-service host, defaults to `http://localhost:5004`
  - `resumeId` / section ids — resumes + their sub-sections (`workExperienceId`, `educationId`, `resumeSkillId`, `languageId`, `projectId`, `certificationId`, `awardId`)
- **Auth**: collection-level Bearer auth using `{{accessToken}}`; public requests override it with `No Auth`.
- **Error shape**: every non-2xx response (except empty-body 401s from the security layer) is
  `{"status":int,"error":str,"message":str,"details":array|null,"timestamp":str}`.

  - `applicationBaseUrl` - application-service host, defaults to `http://localhost:5005`
  - `applicationId` / `noteId` - ids used by the Application Service requests

## Extending
When a new service/API is added, add a new top-level folder and follow the same conventions.
See `postman/README.md` in `common-lib`.

item.name: User Service
item.description:
Authentication and user management APIs (port 5001).

Roles: `ROLE_JOB_SEEKER`, `ROLE_EMPLOYER`, `ROLE_ADMIN`, `ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN`.
User statuses: `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE`, `SUSPENDED`, `DELETED` (soft delete).

item.name: Auth
item.description: Public authentication flows + authenticated password change.

request.description:
Create a new account.

**Body** — `RegisterRequest`:
- `firstName` (required, ≤50), `middleName` (optional, ≤50), `lastName` (required, ≤50)
- `email` (required, valid email, ≤150, unique)
- `password` (required, 8–64, needs upper+lower+digit+special `[@$!%*?&]`)
- `phoneNumber` (optional, `+?[0-9]{7,15}`)
- `userRole` (required): `ROLE_JOB_SEEKER` | `ROLE_EMPLOYER` | `ROLE_ADMIN` | `ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN`

**Responses**
- `201` → `UserResponse` (also saved to `{{registeredUserId}}`)
- `400` → validation failed
- `409` → email already registered

Exchange credentials for a token pair.

**Responses**
- `200` → `AuthResponse` `{ accessToken, refreshToken, tokenType: "Bearer", expiresIn, user }` — tokens are auto-saved into `{{accessToken}}` / `{{refreshToken}}` / `{{userId}}`
- `400` → validation failed
- `401` → invalid credentials
- `403` → account suspended or deleted

Demo seeded accounts: `shoikat@example.com` (ADMIN), `tanvir.chowdhury@example.com` (SUPER_ADMIN), password `DemoPass123!`. 50 demo accounts `demo01…demo50.*@example.com` also exist (see `common-lib/postman/README.md`).

Rotate a refresh token for a new token pair. The used token is revoked (single use); replaying a rotated token revokes the whole family.

**Responses**
- `200` → new `AuthResponse` (auto-saved, replacing the old pair)
- `400` → blank token
- `401` → unknown / expired / revoked / replayed token

Revoke one refresh token (idempotent — unknown tokens still return 204).

**Responses**
- `204` → token revoked (or was already unknown)
- `400` → blank token

Change the password of the authenticated user (Bearer token required).

**Responses**
- `204` → password changed
- `400` → wrong current password, weak new password, or confirm-mismatch
- `401` → not authenticated

item.name: Users
item.description: User management. Self-access allowed for GET/PUT on your own id; everything else requires `ROLE_ADMIN` or `ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN`.

request.description:
Fetch one user. A user may view their own record; any other record requires ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN.

**Responses**
- `200` → `UserResponse`
- `400` → non-numeric id
- `401` → not authenticated
- `403` → viewing someone else's record without an admin role
- `404` → no such user

query.description: optional filter: ROLE_JOB_SEEKER | ROLE_EMPLOYER | ROLE_ADMIN | ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN

request.description:
Paged list of all users, newest first (admin only).

**Responses**
- `200` → Spring `Page<UserResponse>`
- `401` → not authenticated
- `403` → not ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN

Update profile fields. A user may update their own profile; any other profile requires ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN. Email, role and status are NOT editable here.

**Body** — `UpdateUserRequest`: `firstName` (required, ≤50), `middleName` (optional, ≤50), `lastName` (required, ≤50), `phoneNumber` (optional), `profilePictureUrl` (optional, ≤255).

**Responses**
- `200` → updated `UserResponse`
- `400` → validation failed
- `403` → updating someone else's profile without an admin role
- `404` → no such user

Change a user's status (admin only). Suspending revokes all of the user's refresh tokens.

**Body**: `status` = `ACTIVE` | `INACTIVE` | `SUSPENDED` | `DELETED`

**Responses**
- `200` → updated `UserResponse`
- `400` → unknown status / null
- `403` → not ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN
- `404` → no such user

Soft-delete a user (admin only): sets status to `DELETED` and revokes all refresh tokens.

**Responses**
- `204` → deleted
- `403` → not ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN
- `404` → no such user

item.name: Company Service
item.description:
Company profiles, offices and admin verification (port 5002).

Statuses: `PENDING_VERIFICATION`, `ACTIVE`, `SUSPENDED`, `REJECTED`. Sizes: `MICRO`, `SMALL`, `MEDIUM`, `LARGE`, `ENTERPRISE`. Types: `STARTUP`, `PRIVATE`, `PUBLIC_LISTED`, `GOVERNMENT`, `NON_PROFIT`, `EDUCATIONAL`, `SELF_EMPLOYED`. Social platforms: `LINKEDIN`, `TWITTER`, `FACEBOOK`, `GITHUB`, `INSTAGRAM`, `YOUTUBE`, `WEBSITE`.

**Auth note**: JWT is not wired into this service yet. Owner/employer requests carry a temporary `X-User-Id` header (value: `{{userId}}` from the Login script — log in as an `ROLE_EMPLOYER` account first). Admin routes are unsecured for now.

**Responses**
- `200` → Spring `Page<CompanySummaryResponse>`

Fetch one verified, active company by id.

**Responses**

- `404` → no such (or non-active) company

request.description:
Create your company profile. One account owns **at most one company**. The new company starts in `PENDING_VERIFICATION` and only appears in the public search after an admin approval. The slug is derived from `name` (e.g. `acme-labs`), suffixing `-2`, `-3`, ... on collision.

**Body** — `CreateCompanyRequest`:
- `name` (required, ≤150), `tagline` (≤255), `description` (≤5000)
- `logoUrl` / `coverImageUrl` / `website` (http(s) URLs, ≤500)
- `email` (optional, valid email, ≤255), `phone` (optional, ≤20, `+?[1-9][0-9]{1,14}`)
- `foundingYear` (1800–2100), `companySize`, `companyType`, `industryType` (required)
- `registrationNumber` (≤100, globally unique)
- `socialLinks` (≤10; unique `platform` + http(s) `url` each)

The id and slug are saved into `{{companyId}}` / `{{companySlug}}`.

**Responses**
- `201` → `CompanyResponse` (with `companyStatus`)
- `400` → validation failed
- `401` → missing/invalid `X-User-Id`
- `409` → account already owns a company, or registration number in use

item.name: Job Service
item.description:
Job postings, taxonomy (categories/skills/tags), lifecycle and admin moderation.

- Identity: temporary `X-User-Id` header ({{userId}}) until JWT is wired.
- Lifecycle: jobs start **DRAFT**; owners publish (DRAFT->ACTIVE) or close (ACTIVE->CLOSED); admins suspend/reactivate.
- Public reads only ever return **ACTIVE** postings; drafts/closed/deleted are hidden.
- Set {{jobBaseUrl}}, {{jobId}}, {{jobCategoryId}}, {{jobSkillId}}, {{jobTagId}} in collection variables.
- Seed helper: `backend/services/job-service/seed/seed.py`, API smoke suite: `seed/api-tests.sh`.

request.description: Public paged search; ALL filters optional (skip query keys you do not need). Only ACTIVE, not-deleted postings are returned. Filters: `keyword` (title like), `companyId`, `employmentType` (FULL_TIME|PART_TIME|CONTRACT|INTERNSHIP|TEMPORARY?), `experienceLevel`, `workMode` (ON_SITE|HYBRID|REMOTE), `location` (city/country like), `salaryPeriod` (HOURLY|WEEKLY|MONTHLY|YEARLY), `categoryId`, `skillIds`, `tagIds` (repeat or comma list).
Public detail view. 404 unless the job is ACTIVE (drafts/closed/deleted are hidden). Each 200 bumps `viewCount` by 1 (atomic DB update).
Route based on the company service — active postings of one company, ordered by newest.

header.description: Temporary identity header until JWT is wired

request.description: Create a draft posting owned by the requester (`X-User-Id`). 201 + DetailedJobResponse. Validations: salaryMin<=salaryMax, salaryPeriod required with any amount, ON_SITE requires city, category must exist+be active, all skill/tag ids must exist. The slug is generated server-side and unique (-2, -3 suffixes on collision).

Candidate resume builder: resume shells, personal info, summary, default handling and seven sub-section collections.

- Identity: every request — lists included — is owner-scoped via the temporary `X-User-Id` header ({{userId}}); the candidate in the header must own the addressed resume.
- Defaults: the first resume becomes the apply-with default; `set-default` demotes the rest; deleting the default promotes the newest survivor.
- `completionScore` is a 0-100 checklist (personal name/email, summary, and >=1 of each section), recalculated on every change; `lastViewedAt` bumps on each detail GET.
- Set {{resumeBaseUrl}}, {{resumeId}} and the section id variables in collection variables.
- Seed helper: `backend/services/resume-service/seed/seed.py`.

item.name: Application Service
Applications

header.description: temporary auth: user-service id of the caller (candidate or employer)

request.description:
Candidate applies with the resume they want to send. The company id is copied off the job card so employer inboxes can scope by company; ids are unverified stand-ins until cross-service validation lands.

**Body** - `ApplicationRequest`: `jobId` (required), `companyId` (required), `resumeId` (required), `coverLetter` (optional, <=5000), `expectedSalary` (decimal >=0, <=2 fraction digits), `availableFrom` (today or later). The created id is saved into `{{applicationId}}`.

**Responses**
- `201` -> application in `PENDING`
- `400` -> validation failed
- `401` -> missing/invalid `X-User-Id`
- `409` -> a live application for this candidate + job already exists (only withdrawn ones may be re-applied for)

request.description:
Candidate withdrawal from a reviewing status (`PENDING`, `REVIEWING`, `SHORTLISTED`, `INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED`). The reason is optional - an empty body works.

request.description:
Employer status move. Allowed steps: `PENDING` -> `REVIEWING` / `SHORTLISTED` / `INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED` / `REJECTED`; `REVIEWING` -> `SHORTLISTED` / `INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED` / `REJECTED`; `SHORTLISTED` -> `INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED` / `HIRED` / `REJECTED`; `INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED` -> `HIRED` / `REJECTED`. `REJECTED`, `HIRED` and `WITHDRAWN` are terminal; `WITHDRAWN` is candidate-only.

**Responses**
- `200` -> updated application
- `400` -> no-op or `WITHDRAWN` target
- `404` -> row not in this company's inbox
- `409` -> illegal transition
